objective: Corrective product-source-truth reconstruction for EntrepreneurOS. Produce a lossless, provenance-labeled canon that captures every product truth from all source inputs (Google Docs, prior phases, GitHub main, Beast feature branch, UMH projection, operator corrections) without mutation, implementation, or source modification.
center_of_gravity: EOS democratizes the ability to structure, operate, optimize, and scale economic activity. Operator can operate one or more portfolios with entities as execution vehicles. Entities include businesses, investments, startups, real estate, stocks, asset holdings, agencies, SaaS companies, media companies, operating companies.

ownership.note: Lyfe Institute is a company/venture incubated through Empyrean Studios, managed inside EOS

hierarchy: Operator/User -> Portfolio(s) -> Entities -> Business/Investment/Asset Operations -> Teams/Agents/Roles/Permissions -> Workflows/SOPs/Tasks/Tools -> Capital/Transactions/KPIs/Reports -> Outcomes/Proof/Optimization
communication_architecture: User/Founder -> EA Agent -> Portfolio Advisor OR CEO Agent -> Department/Specialist Agents. EA does NOT route directly to department/specialist agents.

ui_shell.aesthetic: Executive command center, business cockpit, finance-grade clarity, strategic control, modern AI-native enterprise. NOT playful, NOT creator-social, NOT RPG.

core_rules: NO implementation — all artifacts are READ-ONLY analysis
NO source mutation — no code changes to any EOS codebase
ALL artifacts are DRAFT with operator_approved=false and allows_implementation=false

Every claim must have provenance label from: SOURCE_PRESERVED_TRUTH, CODE_RESOLVED_CURRENT_TRUTH, SYNTHESIZED_CANON, INFERRED_PROFESSIONAL_GAP, OPEN_QUESTION_OPERATOR_DECISION_REQUIRED, IMPLEMENTATION_DEBT
Code resolves ambiguity — when docs and code disagree, code wins for current truth
Operator corrections override prior phase claims where explicitly stated
Beast feature/company-system is canonical candidate (DEC-145-001) but NOT yet promoted — treat both branches as source
No blind merge — Beast promotion requires build validation, secret scan, operator review, rollback plan
EOS is owned by OST, not Lyfe Institute — correct any prior artifacts that state otherwise
Center of gravity is economic activity democratization, not just founder tooling
Entity model is broader than businesses — includes investments, real estate, stocks, asset holdings, agencies, SaaS, media, operating companies
Communication architecture: User -> EA -> Portfolio Advisor/CEO -> Department agents (EA never routes directly to specialists)
UI aesthetic is executive command center / business cockpit, never playful/RPG/creator-social
Every artifact must include phase, status, operator_approved, allows_implementation, date header

provenance_labels.SOURCE_PRESERVED_TRUTH: Directly from operator-authored documents (Google Docs, operator corrections). No interpretation.
provenance_labels.CODE_RESOLVED_CURRENT_TRUTH: Derived from reading actual source code. Code wins over docs when they conflict.
provenance_labels.SYNTHESIZED_CANON: Synthesized from multiple sources with explicit provenance chain. Analyst judgment applied.
provenance_labels.INFERRED_PROFESSIONAL_GAP: Gap identified from professional standards/best practices not stated in any source document.
provenance_labels.OPEN_QUESTION_OPERATOR_DECISION_REQUIRED: Ambiguity or conflict that only the operator can resolve. Must not be auto-resolved.
provenance_labels.IMPLEMENTATION_DEBT: Known gap between desired state and current implementation. Documented for future work packets.
